description:
BootAsset is a built boot artifact and how to get it. The controller builds the artifact and reports readiness and digest. For strategies without a grant, it also reports a URL.

One-slot BMCs: a BMC with one virtual media slot cannot mount the installer and a config ISO side by side. For a blank machine behind such a BMC, the operator creates an embeddedInstaller BootAsset named `<node>-embedded`. This is an installer for that node with its machine config inside, mounted in the one slot. The operator does not send the config to a machine in maintenance mode, because the machine takes it from anybody who reaches it. The installer reaches the BMC only through the media service and its grants, as a config ISO does.

Secrets at rest: the embedded installer holds the node's machine config in plain text, keys and tokens included. It is on the media store volume (the manager's --media-store), and only the user of the operator can read it. It is deleted with its BootAsset, or when a newer build replaces it. It is not encrypted: use an encrypted StorageClass for the media store where Secrets are encrypted at rest.

validations.message: configISO takes nodeRef and nothing else
factory takes talosVersion (and optionally schematic), never nodeRef
embeddedInstaller takes nodeRef and talosVersion (and optionally schematic)

fields.name: spec
fields.description: BootAssetSpec declares one boot artifact. The strategy decides which of the remaining fields apply; the CEL rules on the kind enforce the pairing.

fields.name: nodeRef
fields.description: NodeRef names the TalosNode whose rendered config the artifact carries. configISO and embeddedInstaller.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the object.

fields.name: schematic
fields.description: Schematic customizes the install image (system extensions, kernel arguments). factory and embeddedInstaller; omitted means the vanilla image.

fields.name: customization
fields.description: SchematicCustomization holds the image customization knobs.

fields.name: extraKernelArgs
fields.description: ExtraKernelArgs append to the image's kernel command line, for example where to put the console (console=ttyS0, what the BMC's serial-over-LAN shows). Do not add talos.config=metal-iso: the operator adds it to the boot medium itself, and the installed system must not carry it.

fields.name: systemExtensions
fields.description: SystemExtensions bakes extensions into the image.

fields.name: officialExtensions
fields.description: OfficialExtensions are siderolabs/* extension names (siderolabs/drbd).

fields.name: strategy
fields.description: Strategy selects how the artifact is produced.

fields.name: talosVersion
fields.description: TalosVersion pins the release of the install image. factory and embeddedInstaller.

fields.name: status
fields.description: BootAssetStatus reports the built artifact. Secret-bearing artifacts never get a stable URL — their fetch URLs are minted per mount as grants and revoked on node check-in, eject, or expiry.

fields.name: artifactSecretRef
fields.description: ArtifactSecretRef is where the built artifact rests (key asset.iso), owned by this BootAsset and GC'd with it. configISO only.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the object.

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: The namespace of the object.

fields.name: buildJob
fields.description: BuildJob is the imager Job of the latest build, in the operator's namespace. A failed Job is kept so its log can be read. embeddedInstaller only.

fields.name: buildKey
fields.description: BuildKey names the inputs of the stored artifact: config, Talos version, schematic and imager image. A change of any input is a new key and a new build. embeddedInstaller only.

fields.name: conditions
fields.description: Conditions: Ready.

fields.name: lastTransitionTime
fields.description: The time of the last change of the status.

fields.name: message
fields.description: A message for people about the last change. It can be empty.

fields.name: observedGeneration
fields.description: The generation of the object that the condition is for. A lower value than metadata.generation shows an old condition.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: A word in CamelCase that tells why the condition has its status.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the condition: True, False or Unknown.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of the condition.

fields.name: configDigest
fields.description: ConfigDigest is the rendered config (the TalosNode's status.configDigest) the stored artifact carries. embeddedInstaller only.

fields.name: digest
fields.description: Digest is sha256:<hex> of the artifact bytes. configISO and embeddedInstaller.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Size is the artifact size in bytes. configISO and embeddedInstaller.

fields.name: url
fields.description: URL is where the artifact is fetched without a grant. factory only.
